title: Resolved tenant entitlement response
description: Entitlement lookup MUST resolve only for an active, unrevoked, unexpired API key whose persisted scopes remain a non-empty unique subset of the provider's current allowlist. Empty, malformed, duplicate, unsupported, or retired scopes MUST fail closed with the same non-disclosing response as an unknown or inactive key.

max_requests.description: Entitlement limits MUST be non-negative safe JSON integers no greater than 9007199254740991; providers MUST fail closed instead of rounding larger persisted BIGINT values.

max_tokens.description: Entitlement limits MUST be non-negative safe JSON integers no greater than 9007199254740991; providers MUST fail closed instead of rounding larger persisted BIGINT values.

max_api_keys.description: Maximum concurrently active, unrevoked, unexpired API keys permitted for the organization. Key creation MUST be denied when the current count is greater than or equal to this limit. The active-key count MUST evaluate expiry after acquiring the per-tenant key-creation serialization lock, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same transaction; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden. The limit and active count MUST remain lossless across persistence, aggregation and JSON serialization for the full safe-integer range. This value MUST be a non-negative safe JSON integer no greater than 9007199254740991; providers MUST fail closed instead of rounding a larger persisted BIGINT value.
